method: Current official primary-source web research. Search result article text and direct opens. No competitor account or hands-on session.
claim_policy: Documented capabilities only. Buildrick findings remain separately supported by local audit artifacts. Missing evidence is not a missing feature. No copied branding, pixel dimensions, complete context-menu order, performance or accessibility claims.

sources.title: Intro to Webflow
sources.claim_scope: Editor toolbar, task panels, component canvas and contextual controls.
sources.limitations: No dimensions or runtime quality inferred.

sources.title: Navigator
sources.claim_scope: Page hierarchy, selection, reorder, canvas highlighting and selected-element handoff.
sources.limitations: Drag accuracy and keyboard accessibility not tested.

sources.title: Webflow canvas overview
sources.claim_scope: Canvas selection, parent navigation, drag placement feedback and preview.
sources.limitations: Does not establish competitor coordinate correctness.

sources.title: Style panel overview
sources.claim_scope: Selectors, affected scope, local/inherited property indicators, source inspection and reset.
sources.limitations: No claim that all inheritance cases work.

sources.title: Variables
sources.claim_scope: Reusable typed values, linked updates, collections and automatic/manual modes.
sources.limitations: Variable modes are optional scope, not a required Buildrick feature.

sources.title: Components overview
sources.claim_scope: Main/instance distinction, properties, slots, variants and contextual/dedicated editing.
sources.limitations: Does not establish Buildrick lacks any corresponding capability.

sources.title: Assets panel
sources.claim_scope: Static asset organization, replace/upload and distinction from CMS assets.
sources.limitations: No storage durability or upload failure test performed.

sources.title: Create and manage Interactions with GSAP
sources.claim_scope: Triggers, actions, targets, timing, reusable presets and preview.
sources.limitations: No recommendation to replace Buildrick runtime/library.

sources.title: Interactions with GSAP vs Classic Interactions
sources.claim_scope: Version-specific interaction support and differing trigger capabilities.
sources.limitations: Avoid treating GSAP and Classic as one universal feature set.

sources.title: How do I publish or unpublish a Webflow site?
sources.claim_scope: Separate staging/custom-domain publishing selection.
sources.limitations: No publish executed; no plan-price comparison.

sources.title: Structure and style Collection pages
sources.claim_scope: Shared collection page template with item-specific content and preview.
sources.limitations: Template semantics only; no runtime CMS benchmark.

sources.title: Pages panel overview
sources.claim_scope: Blank/template creation, drafts, organization, duplication and non-undoable page deletion.
sources.limitations: Documentation last updated 2025-10-03; still current served help page.

sources.title: Keyboard shortcuts in Webflow
sources.claim_scope: Discoverable shortcuts and platform-specific key equivalents.
sources.limitations: Exact chords need not be copied; no keyboard hands-on.

sources.title: Quick find
sources.claim_scope: Searchable entry to entities/actions; new page hands off to Pages creation.
sources.limitations: Does not imply every command bypasses its owning workflow.

sources.title: Comments
sources.claim_scope: Element/breakpoint context, resolve/reopen, links and mentions; refresh needed for new comments.
sources.limitations: Not realtime; no emails sent or permission fixture tested.

sources.title: Expand canvas to see all breakpoints at once
sources.claim_scope: Optional simultaneous breakpoint frames; focused mode for specified tasks.
sources.limitations: Not an accessibility or performance measurement.

sources.title: Learn the Framer interface
sources.claim_scope: Five task views, Pages/Layers/Assets, selection-aware inspector, comment entry and preview/publish distinction.
sources.limitations: Detailed comments permissions and exact panel dimensions not established.

sources.title: Using the canvas
sources.claim_scope: Select/pan/comment tools and zoom/fit controls.
sources.limitations: No native gesture test or geometry correctness claim.

sources.title: Sharing Components
sources.claim_scope: Workspace library entry for reusable components.
sources.limitations: Remote update/retry durability not tested.

sources.title: How to publish a component
sources.claim_scope: Assets component right-click Copy URL; separately released component versions.
sources.limitations: Specific context action only, not exhaustive menu inventory or marketplace recommendation.

sources.title: Generate responsive breakpoints with the Agent
sources.claim_scope: Primary desktop inheritance, narrower overrides and editable responsive layouts.
sources.limitations: AI generation quality not evaluated; no same-width rendering test.

sources.title: Styles
sources.claim_scope: Shared text styles with responsive breakpoint overrides.
sources.limitations: API evidence; not proof of a Webflow-equivalent generic variable-mode UI.

sources.title: Create one reusable page for every CMS item
sources.claim_scope: CMS detail template, field binding, record preview and conditional visibility.
sources.limitations: No live account creation or field-binding test.

sources.title: Working with Images
sources.claim_scope: Image upload, canvas insertion and selection assignment are distinct API operations.
sources.limitations: API evidence does not establish current library folders, retry UI or recovery guarantees.

sources.title: Create and prompt animations in Framer
sources.claim_scope: Layer effects, text animation and component-state transitions.
sources.limitations: No event cleanup or reverse behavior test.

sources.title: Staging and versions
sources.claim_scope: Version-specific links, status/publisher/time, staged vs live assignment and rollback.
sources.limitations: Staging requires a connected custom domain; no deployment performed.

sources.title: Framer Keyboard Shortcuts
sources.claim_scope: Searchable action catalogue with Mac/Windows bindings.
sources.limitations: No claim that every advertised binding works in all focus contexts.

sources.title: How to fix the Module too large warning
sources.claim_scope: Explicit publishing limitation, affected content stays editable and documented remediation.
sources.limitations: Specific failure contract; not evidence that all error feedback is complete.

sources.title: CollectionItem
sources.claim_scope: CMS item draft flag excludes item from publishing.
sources.limitations: Data/API contract, not a current draft-menu layout claim.

sources.title: Design responsive layouts that work on every screen
sources.claim_scope: Relationship-based responsive layout and testing intermediate widths.
sources.limitations: Design teaching, not measured responsive correctness.
